## Setup

- OEWS May 2025 metro file: <https://www.bls.gov/oes/special-requests/oesm25ma.zip>
- BEA Regional Price Parities by metro: the `MARPP` zip from <https://apps.bea.gov/regional/downloadzip.htm>

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(janitor)
```

## Import

```{r}
oews_raw <- read_excel("data/raw/oesm25ma/MSA_M2025_dl.xlsx") |> clean_names()
rpp_raw  <- read_csv("data/raw/MARPP/MARPP_MSA_2008_2024.csv") |> clean_names()
```

## OEWS, May 2025 (metro areas, all occupations)

```{r}
glimpse(oews_raw)
```

## BEA Regional Price Parities (metro areas)

```{r}
glimpse(rpp_raw)
```

## Quick viability check

How many metros actually report a median wage for software developers (SOC 15-1252)?

```{r}
oews_raw |>
  filter(occ_code == "15-1252") |>
  mutate(a_median_num = suppressWarnings(parse_number(as.character(a_median)))) |>
  summarise(
    metros_total       = n(),
    metros_with_median = sum(!is.na(a_median_num)),
    metros_top_coded   = sum(as.character(a_median) == "#", na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

Which RPP lines are in the BEA file? (Used later to pick the all-items and housing rows.)

```{r}
rpp_raw |>
  distinct(line_code, description)
```
